review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Proceed with narrow send refusal classification and scoped recovery repair
review.notes: Review completed before any product/test edits on base1ff. Preserve all existing dispatch/input/draft/identity and authority guards, same-send-id no-replay, receipt/echo generations, key controller and scope fences. Native frontend-unavailable already has explicit association handling: only unknown input-state refusal falls generic asking. Add optional validated wire codes without changing HTTP status or legacy error string compatibility; only explicit known native evidence may explain a question. Legacy asking text is insufficient evidence. Compact recovery remains visible while an explicit retry is pending, synchronous duplicate/captured-callback guards apply, no auto retry. Edit restores the held text without overwriting newer composer text or attachments and clears the old notice; scope change/unmount hides and invalidates it. Existing legacy asking classification/action assertions are intentionally re-reviewed: neutral fallback plus Retry replaces indefinite no-action waiting. Existing authority/no-override/gone/same-ID and late receipt assertions remain meaningful, do not remove them to obtain green. New fixtures in separate files for API/helpers/real screens/Composer; only the two existing copy/component files are adjusted for their newly reviewed presentation contract. Five surfaces: shared RN phone/iPad recovery; CLI/server error wording consumes core classification only; menu-bar and browser keep their existing UI and can ignore optional response code. No new permissions, target recovery, release/install or full native UX claims. Go resource contract42e2829 applies; only one bounded server semantic negative and one final makecheck, reuse same caches and no downloads.
